itemized.notes: STRUCTURE: Schedule A's attachment is ONE SPREADSHEET SPLIT ACROSS TWO PAGE-PAIRS - p4/p5 carry the LEFT half (Date | Last Name | First Name | [redacted address] | City | State | Zip) and p6/p7 carry the RIGHT half (Occupation | Employer | Amount | In-kind). Neither half alone has both a name and an amount. They were rejoined by rendering both at 300 dpi, rotating -90, and pasting on a common y-axis; the join was validated three ways: identical text-row-band counts (37 vs 37 on p4/p6), a scan offset of only 8 px against a 51 px row pitch, the blank-city row (Sandoval) landing on the blank city cell, and finally the exact reconciliation on 23,055.00. Schedule B's attachment (p9-p11) is single-width and needed no join. Donor names print as separate Last/First columns and are recorded as 'Last, First'; organizations print 'N/A' in First Name. The county redaction covers the whole address column, so city and state (the only geography kept) come from their own columns. Pages 4-7 and 9-11 all rotate -90 to read. The In-kind column exists on p6/p7 and is EMPTY for every row.
